div.strong: Production environment is set, but the API key is a sandbox key.
div.p: Shipments created with this carrier will be validated by DHL but will not enter the network and will not be billed. Either switch the toggle at the top of this form to Test Environment, or replace the API key with a production key from My DHL Parcel.

div.strong: Test environment is set, but the API key is a production key.
div.p: Shipments created with this carrier will be real DHL shipments and will be billed. Either switch the toggle at the top of this form to Production Environment, or replace the API key with a sandbox key from My DHL Parcel.

div.strong: You cannot see or edit the DHL API credentials.
div.p: Access to the DHL User ID, API Key and Account ID is restricted to members of the group "DHL Parcel Administrator". Your regular delivery-carrier permissions are not affected: you can still create, edit and use this carrier, validate deliveries and print labels. Only the credential fields themselves are hidden.

To edit credentials yourself, ask an Odoo administrator to add you to the group via Settings > Users > (your user) > Access Rights > Other > DHL Parcel Administrator. Alternatively, an administrator can enter the credentials on this form directly.

div.strong: No DHL API Key yet? Read this first.
div.p: API access is not part of a standard DHL eCommerce Benelux contract. Before you can create keys in the My DHL Parcel portal, DHL has to activate the API role on your account.

How to request it: email your DHL contact (or DHL eCommerce support), mention your DHL customer number, and ask them to enable API access on your account so you can generate API keys via the portal. Until they confirm, the portal only shows a "Connections" page and no API Keys section - that is the signal that this step is not yet done. Once active, log into the portal, go to Settings > API Keys, create a key, and paste User ID, API Key and Account ID here.

button.name: action_dhlparcel_test_connection
button.help: Authenticate against DHL and probe a read-only endpoint to confirm the credentials work.

group.p: The DHL Parcel API does not return live shipping rates, so the customer price is set here. Choose Flat price for a fixed amount, or Weight-based rules and define tiers on the Pricing tab (use weight as the variable).

Which of the DHL products this carrier resolves to (per destination country and recipient type) are actually active on your DHL contract? Runs a live probe against DHL's API. Countries flagged NOT IN CONTRACT will fail at label creation - contact DHL to activate the missing product on your account, or uncheck those countries on the Destination Availability tab of this carrier.

button.name: action_dhlparcel_verify_contract
button.help: Iterate the enabled destination countries and check whether the DHL product this carrier would use for each route is available on your DHL contract.

page.name: dhlparcel_tariffs
page.p: Set a price per parcel type, as charged to the customer. For MIX shipping methods the shipping cost is computed as sum(qty × tariff) over all the parcels on the delivery. Re-run Add Shipping on the sales order after filling in the DHL Parcels tab to refresh the price on the order.
